text:
claire: serious question for the team: cream or no cream in morning coffee? this is important. :coffee: 

ton y: no cream. black coffee or bust. your soul becomes more efficient. :muscle: 

maya: creamer. oat milk forever. extra foam if it's Friday. :sparkles: 

ian: half-and-half. can't commit to full cream but also can't do black. the compromise life.

claire: hypothetical stake: if you bring in donuts, you get to enforce everyone's coffee preference for the day. fair? :donut:

ton y: deal but only if the donut is maple glazed. lowball maple glazed, and it's war.

maya: i'd accept donut diplomacy. also curious: any coffee machines in office that actually make good espresso?

dev-bot: Office appliance status: "Double-shot espresso machine" maintenance due in 3 days. Last serviced 2025-10-12.

ian: oof time to schedule a coffee-crew maintenance shift. i'm volunteering for the descaling ritual.

claire: vote time: 1) black, 2) oat creamer, 3) half-and-half, 4) other (reply). react with :one: :two: :three: :four:.

ton y: :one:

maya: :two:

ian: :three:

claire: results so far: split. we'll settle with donut diplomacy next Tuesday. whoever brings the donuts wins the coffee edict.

ton y: i'll bring maple glazed. prepare to be ruled. :crown:

claire: closing this non-work referendum. thanks for the hot takes and the impending pastries :)
